pairs.summary: FOSL2::JUND and Nr1h3 motifs co-occur in the same accessible ~300 bp windows more often than expected after matching GC, accessibility and repeat content, in 7 of 14 profiles analysed (DLD-1 colorectal adenocarcinoma; HepG2 hepatoblastoma/liver cancer; K562 chronic myelogenous leukemia; SW480 colorectal adenocarcinoma (primary); ...). Median lift 1.22x, typical spacing ~64 bp between sites. In 5 profile(s) the enrichment is seen in both replicate halves and the motifs are distinguishable. Caution: dimer motif — the signal may reflect one family/shared motif rather than two distinct factors. This is a sequence-level hypothesis to test (e.g. ChIP/CUT&RUN co-binding, motif mutagenesis), not a confirmed interaction. Evidence: motif co-occurrence only (ChromBPNet not yet run for this pair).
